biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on money you were already going to spend — it is not income and not guaranteed earnings. Rates can be lowered or withdrawn by retailers, and tracking can fail if you use another coupon code or an ad blocker.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — rates and retailers change, and merchants can decline or adjust claims.
Tracking is not instant: allow about 7 days before raising a missing-cashback claim.
There is no general minimum, but individual payout methods can impose their own thresholds — check before you withdraw.
Using external coupon codes, ad blockers, or private browsing can break tracking and void the rebate.

payout_quote: Cashback tracks within about 7 days, becomes payable after the retailer's return period and commission confirmation, then stays in your account until you withdraw it via bank transfer, PayPal, or gift cards.

s6.note: 7 concrete actions: sign up, click through, shop, check tracking, wait for payable status, withdraw.

steps: Create a free account at https://www.topcashback.com/.
Search for the retailer and confirm the cashback rate before you shop.
Click through TopCashback to the retailer's site in the same browser session — do not apply coupon codes from other sites on the same order.
Check your TopCashback account within about 7 days to confirm the cashback tracked.
Wait until the cashback status changes to payable after the retailer's return period and commission confirmation.
Withdraw your payable balance via bank transfer, PayPal, or gift cards.
timing: Cashback usually appears within about 7 days of purchase; becomes payable after the retailer's return period and commission confirmation. No general payout minimum — individual payout methods can set their own thresholds.

weasel_words.quote: Rates are shown as percentages that vary by retailer and can be changed or removed at any time; payable status depends on the retailer confirming the commission.
